definitions.success: requested target completed with valid point and inference outputs
definitions.calibration_failure: DGP calibration or generated-input validity failed
definitions.full_fit_failure: supplied or selected full-panel coefficient fit failed numerical checks
definitions.rank_selection_failure: selected-mode candidate comparison could not return a rank
definitions.rank_at_cap: selected rank reached an imposed cap
definitions.candidate_numerically_unresolved: no stable candidate post-refit was eligible
definitions.coefficient_bound_hit: a fitted coefficient reached the box boundary
definitions.target_unsupported_selected_rank: full fitted tangent space did not support the target
definitions.split_fit_failure: one of exactly four split coefficient fits failed
definitions.split_rank_loss: a split fit lost a supplied numerical rank
definitions.split_target_support_loss: a split tangent space did not support the target
definitions.riesz_solver_failure: the target-specific Riesz equation did not converge
definitions.riesz_target_instability: the target-specific Rayleigh diagnostic violated its floor
definitions.nonfinite_estimate: the primary point estimate was nonfinite
definitions.nonfinite_standard_error: the primary standard error was nonfinite
definitions.invalid_variance: the variance was nonfinite or nonpositive
definitions.software_exception: an otherwise unclassified software exception was recorded
